direction: Each illustration represents its ebook's title and topic. Palettes and compositions vary by subject; there is no shared green treatment. Existing HTML supplies the title and author.

covers.subject: A wise mentor's weathered hand offering a small brass compass to a younger traveller at a sunlit crossroads, mountains far beyond; clearly about practical guidance and wisdom
covers.palette: warm sandstone, brass, soft sky blue

covers.subject: A single monumental tree shown across time: ancient exposed annual growth rings and gnarled trunk on one side, fresh branching growth and a geometric upward spiral on the other; distinguish chronological age from development
covers.palette: copper, amber, ivory, restrained spring leaf tones

covers.subject: A small lone human figure taking a step onto a bridge that is forming from luminous stones over a deep chasm, held by conviction rather than proof
covers.palette: midnight violet, gold light, pale lilac

covers.subject: A person seen from behind facing an ornate fractured mirror which reflects a magnificent false city while the real room is crumbling; illusion and mistaken perception are unmistakable
covers.palette: smoky purple, tarnished silver, dusty rose

covers.subject: A large richly textured planet visibly bending a luminous spacetime grid, with smaller moons following precise orbital paths; scientifically inspired gravity, not astrology
covers.palette: deep indigo, cosmic black, icy white, copper

covers.subject: A lone mountaineer reaching an immense sunlit summit above clouds, their long difficult stair-like ridge clearly visible below; earned achievement and aspiration
covers.palette: sunrise gold, white snow, slate blue

covers.subject: A monumental volcanic fissure and towering sculptural flames over black obsidian stone, molten lava pouring below; beautiful severe infernal fire, no violence or suffering
covers.palette: incandescent orange, ember red, obsidian black

covers.subject: An enormous stepped stone ziggurat with distinct ordered levels and increasingly smaller terraces, ascending from many foundation blocks to one luminous apex; hierarchy made architectural
covers.palette: terracotta, weathered limestone, bronze, pale desert sky

covers.subject: A polished sheathed ceremonial sword laid over a white cloak beside an intact wax seal and olive sprig, on a stone altar; an oath, dignity and restraint
covers.palette: crimson, ivory, steel silver, restrained gold

covers.subject: An artisan carefully assembling a glowing lantern from individual crystalline pieces at a workbench; a small inner flame becomes a strong radiant light through deliberate craft
covers.palette: honey gold, warm amber, charcoal, clear white light

covers.subject: An impossible dream world unfolding from a child's simple paper boat: floating islands, an upside-down waterfall, a whale swimming through clouds, an impossible staircase; abundant creative invention
covers.palette: cobalt blue, coral, apricot, lavender, pearlescent white

covers.subject: A luminous human silhouette carrying a brilliant light within the chest while walking from a dark earthly landscape toward a vast sunrise; the light leaves a constellation-like trail of meaningful acts
covers.palette: radiant white, warm gold, midnight blue

covers.subject: An ancient bronze balance scale at a forked stone path, one pan holding a feather and the other a human hand-shaped stone; ethical judgment and consequences, not monetary wealth
covers.palette: aged bronze, ivory, charcoal, muted burgundy

covers.subject: A luminous sculptural human heart formed from ruby glass and branching living vessels, glowing with warm life inside; unmistakably a heart and the center of identity, elegant not bloody or medical-gory
covers.palette: deep crimson, ruby red, warm rose, black cherry

covers.subject: An elegant translucent human head in profile containing a luminous network of neurons and layered geometric thought structures; cognition, awareness and the inner world
covers.palette: electric blue, cyan, silver, midnight navy

covers.subject: An abundant tranquil garden with clear turquoise water, fruit-laden trees, white blossoms, bright marble terraces and open sunlight; unmistakably a peaceful flourishing paradise
covers.palette: turquoise, fresh botanical green, white, sunlit peach

covers.subject: A sumptuous intimate still life of ripe figs, strawberries, velvet fabric, rose petals and a crystal goblet catching warm light; sensory pleasure and delight, tasteful and contemplative
covers.palette: plum, rose pink, raspberry, warm amber

covers.subject: A monumental crowned lion resting confidently on a dark stone throne above a stormy landscape, protective rather than attacking; authority, strength and self-command
covers.palette: royal purple, bronze gold, charcoal

covers.subject: A single flawless white lotus above perfectly clear water, with a transparent crystal and untouched snow-like marble; absolute clarity and unblemished purity
covers.palette: white, pearl, pale ice blue, silver

covers.subject: A beautifully detailed open book in a warm lamplit library, pages becoming a small path into a world of knowledge beyond; reading and discovery, no readable printed text
covers.palette: warm sepia, chestnut brown, cream parchment, amber

covers.subject: A perfectly sharp clear glass sphere revealing the solid physical landscape behind it while painted theatrical scenery peels away at the edges; actual reality beneath appearances
covers.palette: neutral stone, clear daylight blue, steel silver

covers.subject: A precise brass geometric compass drawing an intelligible luminous construction over marble, a straight illuminated path emerging from a labyrinth; logical deduction and rational clarity
covers.palette: ivory, brass, ink navy

covers.subject: A human silhouette standing before two diverging doors while a small warm light over their heart guides them toward the honest path; inward moral awareness, intimate and quiet
covers.palette: warm cream, midnight blue, restrained amber

covers.subject: One continuous luminous ribbon weaving without interruption from a seed through a living tree into a starfield, linking changing stages as one seamless flow; no isolated collage panels
covers.palette: violet, flowing cyan, rose gold, deep space blue

covers.subject: One final monumental stone doorway at the end of a long path, opening onto a still brilliant horizon, with a final stone step and no path beyond; closure, completion and ultimate threshold
covers.palette: black marble, pale white gold, soft ash gray

covers.subject: A detailed living seed germinating: branching roots below, a tender unfolding leaf above, water droplets and warm sunlight; the organic process of life clearly visible as one unified living organism
covers.palette: fresh leaf green, warm earth brown, clear water blue, sunlit gold

covers.subject: A finely engraved fountain pen hovering above cream paper, dark blue ink flowing from its nib and becoming expressive birds and a written world; authorship and expression, no readable lettering
covers.palette: ink blue, parchment ivory, copper

covers.subject: A sheer silver veil moving in an otherwise empty arched room, revealing faint luminous particles and the suggestion of hidden architecture beyond what the eye can see; serene mystery, not horror
covers.palette: moonlit silver, midnight indigo, soft violet

covers.subject: An expressive translucent head in profile with many small luminous origami birds, threads and cloud-like ideas emerging and interconnecting above it; thoughts taking form
covers.palette: cerulean blue, white, pale peach, gold sparks

covers.subject: A single brilliant beam of pure white light passing through a flawless clear prism and revealing a sharply defined real object behind a falling translucent veil; revelation, honesty, optical clarity
covers.palette: pure white, clear crystal, subtle spectrum colors, cool slate

covers.subject: Two complex interlocking transparent puzzle forms and branching lines meeting in one coherent luminous whole, with a precisely completed bridge in the background; comprehension and ideas connecting
covers.palette: teal blue, warm amber, ivory

covers.subject: A visibly cracked delicate porcelain vessel beside a small vulnerable sapling bowed by wind, a restrained line of gold repair suggesting awareness and resilience; fragility treated with dignity
covers.palette: pale porcelain blue, ash gray, soft ochre

covers.subject: An immense rough stone suspended opposite one delicate feather on a heavy brass balance, the stone's gravity visibly tensioning its chains; physical and existential weight
covers.palette: granite gray, brass, parchment cream, deep charcoal
